summary: POET TECHNOLOGIES INC. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting and recapping the CEO's update on commercial activities. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing discusses production ramp timelines, capital raising, and customer engagements but does not involve a transaction or corporate action that qualifies as a special situation under the defined categories.
